_credits: Bathymetry © Coeur d'Alene Tribe & Avista Corp. (public, credit requested). Lake outlines: USGS NHD High Resolution / USGS 3DHP (US public domain). Aerial imagery: Esri World Imagery. Dock locations: computer-vision extraction from aerial imagery (screening-grade). Analysis: lakezones pipeline.
_accuracy: Screening-grade, not navigation-grade. Distances are measured from the NHD/3DHP full-pool shoreline; depths (where shown) reference the 2,128 ft summer full pool, and winter drawdown (~7 ft) shrinks every zone. Dock detections are automated and include some false positives. On large downsampled waters the web grid slightly overstates water area (worst: Coeur d'Alene ~7%); river reaches are exported at native resolution with a half-cell distance correction, and the Python pipeline is authoritative.

coeur_dalene_lake.depth: Coeur d'Alene Tribe / Avista bathymetry (2004): 5/10-ft depth contours to ~210 ft, from Post Falls Dam relicensing surveys (single-beam, late-1990s–2000s).
coeur_dalene_lake.note: Web map is downsampled to ~70 m cells (large lake), so no dock layer here.

spokane_river_95_bridge_to_post_falls_da.depth: River reach between the Hwy 95 bridge and Post Falls Dam — no open bathymetry. Analyzed geometry-only. Outline: USGS 3DHP (2023) waterbody, the same shoreline used in the HLWID ArcGIS draft (665.9 ac), so acreages reconcile with that model.
spokane_river_95_bridge_to_post_falls_da.docks: CV-extracted from Esri aerial imagery (screening-grade). The HLWID ArcGIS draft buffers from shore only; this map can also measure from docks (toggle).
spokane_river_95_bridge_to_post_falls_da.note: Designated no-wake zones (upstream of 300 ft below the Hwy 95 bridge, Black Bay, and Templins Marina to Post Falls Dam) are digitized from landmark descriptions and are APPROXIMATE pending official HLWID boundaries. Distance grid is half-cell corrected; shore-only acreages reconcile with the HLWID ArcGIS buffer model within ~5%, erring conservative (less legal water shown). The reach's two cut ends (bridge and dam) are treated as shore. Log booms, piers, and caution areas (shallows, rocks, swim/camp areas) are not yet digitized — pending HLWID's Google Earth data. Rules referring to swimmers or moving boats cannot be mapped.

spokane_river_post_falls_to_stateline.depth: River reach below Post Falls Dam — no bathymetry (the tribal survey stops at the falls). Analyzed geometry-only.
spokane_river_post_falls_to_stateline.note: Segment clipped at Post Falls Dam and the Idaho–Washington state line; distances near those two cut ends treat the cut as shore, so they read slightly conservative. River level below the dam varies with dam operations more than a natural shoreline. Exported at native 10 m with the half-cell distance correction (narrow rivers are all edge, so coarser grids overstate acreage).

fernan_lake.depth: A University of Idaho sounding survey exists (2014–15) but is CC BY-NC-SA (non-commercial), so it is kept out of this tool. Analyzed geometry-only.
fernan_lake.docks: CV-extracted from Esri aerial imagery (screening-grade; a shallow, partly-marshy lake, so expect more false positives here).
